title: Prompting Strategy Effects Depend on the Judge: A Multilingual Study of LLM-as-a-Judge Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2610.31172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is increasingly applied to multilingual tasks, yet prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Role Conditioning are recommended based solely on English benchmarks. Whether their effectiveness transfers across judge models and languages remains unknown: prompt-sensitivity studies are largely English-centric, while existing multilingual judge studies fix the prompt template. In this work, we address this gap by measuring this interaction through a benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, 27 languages, and 4 tasks across 13 datasets, yielding over 1M pointwise scores on gold-reference outputs, validated against human judgments. We find that prompting strategies are not transferable: the choice of the judge model dominates the choice of prompting strategy, strategy effects reverse direction across judges, and stability degrades in low-resource languages, where these effects are concealed by

translated_title: 提示策略效果取决于评判模型：LLM作为评判者鲁棒性的多语言研究
translated_abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge（大语言模型作为评判者）评估正日益应用于多语言任务，然而诸如思维链和角色条件化等提示策略的推荐仅基于英语基准。这些策略的有效性能否跨评判模型和语言迁移仍是未知数：提示敏感性研究大多以英语为中心，而现有的多语言评判研究则固定了提示模板。在本工作中，我们通过一个基准测试来衡量这种交互作用，该基准涵盖9种提示策略、4个开源权重评判模型、27种语言以及跨越13个数据集的4个任务，在黄金参考输出上产生了超过100万个逐点评分，并经过人工判断的验证。我们发现提示策略是不可迁移的：评判模型的选择主导了提示策略的选择，策略效果在不同评判模型之间会发生方向反转，且在低资源语言中稳定性下降，而这些影响被掩盖……
tldr: 该研究通过涵盖9种提示策略、4个开源评判模型、27种语言的大规模基准测试（超过100万条评分），首次发现LLM-as-a-Judge评估中的提示策略效果不可跨模型和语言迁移——评判模型的选择比提示策略的选择更具决定性，且策略效果在不同评判模型间会反向。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, and 27 languages yielding over 1M scores, this study reveals that prompting strategy effects in LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation are not transferable across judge models and languages, with the choice of judge model dominating the choice of prompting strategy.
